# `fnox lease cleanup`

- **Usage:** `fnox lease cleanup`

Revoke all expired leases that need manual cleanup

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Ask backends to clean up expired tracked leases that require manual revocation. Backend credentials and network access may be needed.

```sh
fnox lease cleanup
```
